Smoke a Joint, Keep Your License!
July 1st Marks The Final Sunset Date of California’s 
"Smoke a Joint, Lose Your License Law."

See
Canadian Study Confirms That Marijuana Impairs Driving Far Less Than Alcohol

July 1, 1999
From canorml@igc.apc.org
(Dale Gieringer)

Happy Independence Day!

July 1st marks the final sunset date of California’s obnoxious "Smoke a Joint, Lose Your License Law." There have been no legislative attempts to revive the law, passed by a reluctant legislature at the insistence of Gov. Wilson two years ago.

July 1, 1999
From canorml@igc.apc.org
(Dale Gieringer)

Happy Independence Day!

July 1st marks the final sunset date of California’s obnoxious "Smoke a Joint, Lose Your License Law." There have been no legislative attempts to revive the law, passed by a reluctant legislature at the insistence of Gov. Wilson two years ago.

Henceforth Californians will no longer get an automatic six-month driving license suspension upon conviction of marijuana possession or other drug offenses.

California now reverts to having the most liberal cannabis laws in the nation, having both decriminalized marijuana and legalized medical cannabis.
